<script>
(function () {
  function setLang(lang) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.lang-content').forEach(function (el) {
      el.hidden = el.getAttribute('data-lang') !== lang;
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.lang-btn').forEach(function (el) {
      el.classList.toggle('active', el.getAttribute('data-lang') === lang);
    });
    document.documentElement.lang = lang;
  }
  function saved() {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem('lang') === 'az' ? 'az' : 'en';
    } catch (err) {
      return 'en';
    }
  }
  if (window.langToggleReady) return;
  window.langToggleReady = true;
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var btn = e.target.closest('.lang-btn');
    if (!btn) return;
    var lang = btn.getAttribute('data-lang');
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('lang', lang);
    } catch (err) {}
    setLang(lang);
  });
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () { setLang(saved()); });
  setLang(saved());
})();
</script>
